extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners and patent practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and form-paragraph standards for drafting Office actions, handling suspensions/deferrals, affidavit/declaration evaluations, and accelerated-examination procedural requirements in U.S. patent prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of interference/concession form paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: This form paragraph should be used only after applicant has been notified that interference proceedings must be instituted before the claims can be allowed and applicant has refused to copy the claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 2, insert --102(g)-- or --102(g)/103(a)--. In bracket 4, insert the patent number, and --in view of _____-- if another reference is also relied upon. When the rejection is under pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 103(a), the examiner’s basis for a finding of obviousness should be included. Note that interferences may include obvious variants, see MPEP Chapter 2300. Explain the formal matters which must be corrected in bracket 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quayle Action - Application Under Accelerated Examination (¶7.51.AE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application is in condition for allowance except for formal matters; prosecution on the merits is closed in accordance with Ex parte Quayle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since this application has special status under the accelerated examination program, a shortened statutory period for reply is TWO (2) MONTHS from the mailing date. Extensions may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a) but filing a petition for extension will remove the application from the accelerated program. Objective of AE is to complete examination within 12 months from filing; to meet that objective replies must be filed electronically via EFS-Web; if not filed electronically final disposition may occur later than 12 months. Examiner Notes: (1) Explain the formal matters in bracket 1. (2) Use only in applications filed on/after Aug 25, 2006 and granted special status under AE or under 37 CFR 1.102(c)(2) or (d). (3) Do not use for special status under 1.102(c)(1) (health/age) or PPH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension of Action, Awaiting New Reference (¶7.52)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ex parte prosecution is SUSPENDED FOR A PERIOD OF [1] MONTHS from the mailing date when a reference relevant to examination may soon become available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maximum period for suspension is 6 months. Only the Technology Center (TC) Director can grant second or subsequent suspensions; such approval must appear on the Office letter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Deferral of Examination under 37 CFR 1.103(d), Granted (¶7.54.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s request for deferral of examination under 37 CFR 1.103(d) has been approved; examination will be deferred for [2] months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner Note: In bracket 1 insert the filing date of the request; in bracket 2 insert number of months for the deferral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Termination of a Suspension of Action, Granted (¶7.54.02)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s request for termination of a suspension of action under 37 CFR 1.103 has been approved; the suspension has been terminated on the date of mailing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner Note: In bracket 1 insert the filing date of the request for termination of the suspension of action. Maximum period for suspension is six months; TC Director must approve all second or subsequent suspensions and his/her signature must appear on the letter granting any second/subsequent suspension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension of Action, Possible Interference (¶7.53)
rubrics_metrics.description: All claims are allowable but ex parte prosecution is SUSPENDED FOR A PERIOD OF [1] MONTHS due to a potential interference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upon expiration applicant should inquire as to status. Maximum suspension period is six months. TC Director must approve second/subsequent suspensions and his/her signature must appear on such letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension of Action, Applicant’s Request (¶7.54)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to applicant’s request filed on [1], action is suspended under 37 CFR 1.103(a) for [2] months; at end applicant must notify examiner and request continuance of prosecution or further suspension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 insert the filing date of the request for termination of the suspension of action. See MPEP § 709 for further procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Suspension Denied - Outstanding Office Action (¶7.56)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s request for suspension under 37 CFR 1.103(a) is denied as improper when action cannot be suspended in an application awaiting a reply by the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP § 709.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Suspension under 37 CFR 1.103(b)/(c) Denied (¶7.56.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s request filed [1] for suspension under 37 CFR 1.103(b) or (c) is denied as improper because it was not filed at the time of filing a CPA or RCE, and/or not accompanied by requisite fee under 37 CFR 1.17(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 insert the filing date of the request for suspension of action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Deferral of Examination under 37 CFR 1.103(d), Denied (¶7.56.02)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s request for deferral of examination under 37 CFR 1.103(d) filed on [1] is denied as improper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 2 insert the reason(s) for denying the request. Examples: applicant has not filed a request under 37 CFR 1.213(b) to rescind a nonpublication request; a first Office action has been issued; applicant has not submitted a request for voluntary publication under 37 CFR 1.221. See MPEP § 709.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration form paragraphs must be preceded by 7.57.fti when indicated
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain affidavit/declaration form paragraphs must be preceded by form paragraph 7.57.fti.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several form paragraphs (e.g., 7.59.fti, 7.61.fti, 7.62.fti, 7.63.fti) explicitly require being preceded by 7.57.fti; ensure correct sequence when responding to or evaluating affidavits/declarations under 37 CFR 1.131(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective Because Reference Is a Statutory Bar (pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 102(b)) (¶7.60.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] reference is a statutory bar under pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 102(b) and thus cannot be overcome by an affidavit or declaration under 37 CFR 1.131(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The affidavit/declaration filed on [2] has been considered but is ineffective to overcome the [3] reference. This paragraph must be followed by one or more of form paragraphs 7.58.fti to 7.63.fti or a paragraph setting forth proper basis for the insufficiency (e.g., failure to establish acts performed in this country or that scope of the declaration is not commensurate with the claims).

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective Because Reference Claims Same Invention (¶7.58.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] reference is a U.S. patent or U.S. patent application publication of a pending or patented application that claims the rejected invention; an affidavit/declaration under 37 CFR 1.131(a) is inappropriate when the reference is claiming interfering subject matter as defined in 37 CFR 41.203(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the reference and this application are not commonly owned, the reference can only be overcome by establishing priority in interference proceedings (see MPEP Chapter 2300). If commonly owned, the reference may be disqualified as prior art by an affidavit/declaration under 37 CFR 1.131(c). Use 7.57.fti before 7.58.fti if responding to an actual submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective - Insufficient Evidence of Reduction to Practice Before Reference Date (¶7.59.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The evidence submitted is insufficient to establish a reduction to practice of the invention prior to the effective date of the [1] reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 7.57.fti. Use appropriate additional paragraphs as required for other deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective - Insufficient Evidence of Conception (¶7.61.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The evidence submitted is insufficient to establish conception of the invention prior to the effective date of the [1] reference. Conception is the mental part of the inventive act and must be capable of proof (demonstrative evidence or complete disclosure to another); more than a vague idea is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An explanation of the deficiency must be provided in bracket 2. If affidavit also fails to establish diligence or reduction to practice, follow with 7.62.fti and/or 7.63.fti. If either diligence or reduction to practice is established, include a statement to that effect after this paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective - Diligence Lacking (¶7.62.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The evidence submitted is insufficient to establish diligence from a date prior to the date of reduction to practice of the [1] reference to either a constructive or actual reduction to practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 7.57.fti. If affidavit also fails to establish conception, 7.61.fti must precede. If affidavit establishes conception, add a statement to that effect. In bracket 2 insert the filing date of the affidavit/declaration; bracket 3 insert affected claim(s); bracket 4 indicate the rejection overcome including statutory grounds (e.g., 35 U.S.C. 112(a), 35 U.S.C. 101, 35 U.S.C. 103, etc.). See MPEP § 715.07(a) regarding diligence not required after reduction to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective - Insufficient Evidence of Actual Reduction to Practice (¶7.63.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The evidence submitted is insufficient to establish applicant’s alleged actual reduction to practice of the invention in this country or a NAFTA/WTO member country after the effective date of the [1] reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.57.fti. If alleged reduction to practice is prior to the effective date of the reference, use 7.59.fti instead. If affidavit also fails to establish conception or diligence, include 7.61.fti and/or 7.62.fti before this paragraph. Provide explanation of lack of showing in bracket 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Effective To Overcome Reference (¶7.64.fti)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] (affidavit/declaration) filed on [2] under 37 CFR 1.131(a) is sufficient to overcome the [3] reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 insert either --affidavit-- or --declaration--. In bracket 2 insert the filing date. In bracket 3 insert the name of the reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration under 37 CFR 1.132 Effective To Withdraw Rejection (¶7.65)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] under 37 CFR 1.132 filed [2] is sufficient to overcome the rejection of claim [3] based upon [4].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 insert either --affidavit-- or --declaration--. In bracket 2 insert filing date. In bracket 3 insert affected claim(s). In bracket 4 indicate the statutory grounds for the rejection addressed (e.g., 35 U.S.C. 112(a), 35 U.S.C. 101, 35 U.S.C. 103, etc.). If insufficient, set forth reasons (untimely; fails to set forth facts; facts not germane; showing not commensurate in scope) and include detailed explanation. Use any of form paragraphs 7.66.01–7.66.05 as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Insufficient - Affiant Never Saw Invention (¶7.66.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes statements amounting to an affirmation that the affiant has never seen the claimed subject matter before; this is not relevant to nonobviousness and provides no objective evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 7.66. Provide a full explanation if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Insufficient - Invention Works as Intended (¶7.66.02)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements that the claimed subject matter functions as intended are not relevant to nonobviousness and provide no objective evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precede with form paragraph 7.66. Provide full explanation if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Insufficient - Refers Only to Invention, Not to Claims (¶7.66.03)
rubrics_metrics.description: The submission refers only to the system described in another application and not to the individual claims, so objective evidence is not commensurate in scope with the claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by form paragraph 7.66. Provide full explanation if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Insufficient - No Evidence of Long-Felt Need (¶7.66.04)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement that the claimed subject matter solved a long-standing problem without showing that others of ordinary skill were working on the problem or that, even knowing the cited references, they would be unable to solve it, is insufficient evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by form paragraph 7.66. Provide full explanation if appropriate. See MPEP § 716.04.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit/Declaration Insufficient - Conclusion (¶7.66.05)
rubrics_metrics.description: When totality of rebuttal evidence fails to outweigh evidence of obviousness, conclude that the affidavit/declaration is insufficient to overcome obviousness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present as a conclusion and precede by form paragraph 7.66.

rubrics_metrics.name: AIA-specific: Affidavit/Declaration under 37 CFR 1.130 Effective to Disqualify via 35 U.S.C. 102(b) (¶7.67.aia)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] under 37 CFR 1.130 [2] filed on [3] is sufficient to overcome the rejection of claim [4] based on [5].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 7.66. Provide full explanation when appropriate. (Note: used in AIA-examined cases where 35 U.S.C. 102/103 as amended is applicable—follow bracket instructions for inserting affida vit/declaration type, subsection, filing date, claims, references, and explanation of reliance on exception provisions of 35 U.S.C. 102(b)(1) or 102(b)(2).)

rubrics_metrics.name: AIA-specific: Affidavit/Declaration Ineffective to Disqualify via 35 U.S.C. 102(b) (¶7.68.aia)
rubrics_metrics.description: The [1] under 37 CFR 1.130 [2] filed on [3] is insufficient to overcome the rejection of claim [4] based upon [5] because [6].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by 7.03.aia and 7.66 where required. In bracket 6 insert explanation of how the affidavit/declaration fails to provide evidence of reliance on an exception provision of 35 U.S.C. 102(b)(1) or 102(b)(2). Use appropriate bracket insertions as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated Accelerated Examination Support Document Required for Claim Amendments Not Encompassed (¶7.70.AE)
rubrics_metrics.description: For any claim amendments (including new claims) not encompassed by previously filed preexamination search and AE support documents, applicant must provide updated preexamination search and AE support documents that encompass the amended/new claims at the time of filing the amendment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to provide such documents at time of amendment filing will cause the amendment to be treated as not fully responsive and not entered. Include this paragraph (and 7.71.AE) in every Office action other than allowance for AE applications filed on/after Aug 25, 2006 or granted special status under 37 CFR 1.102(c)(2) or (d). Do not use for special status under 1.102(c)(1) (health/age) or PPH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Of Proper Document and Fee Codes When Filing Electronically Via EFS-Web – AE (¶7.71.AE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any reply or other papers must be filed electronically via EFS-Web; replies must include a document filed using the document description 'Accelerated Exam - Transmittal amendment/reply' and must use proper indexing and fee codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant reminded to use proper indexing for documents to avoid processing delays. Incorrect document description or fee code may delay processing. Provide links to document descriptions and EFS quick-start. Include this paragraph (and 7.70.AE) in every Office action other than allowance for AE applications filed on/after Aug 25, 2006 or granted special status under 37 CFR 1.102(c)(2) or (d). Do not use for 1.102(c)(1) or PPH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction Letter Re Last Office Action (¶7.81)
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to applicant’s [1] regarding the last Office action, corrective action is taken and the period for reply of [2] MONTHS set in said Office action is restarted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 insert --telephone inquiry of _____-- or --communication dated ______--. In bracket 2 insert new period for reply. This paragraph must be followed by one or more of form paragraphs 7.82, 7.82.01 or 7.83. Before restarting the period the SPE should be consulted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of Reference Citation (¶7.82)
rubrics_metrics.description: The reference [1] was not correctly cited in the last Office action; the correct citation is shown on the attached PTO-892.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every correction MUST be reflected on a corrected or new PTO-892. This paragraph must follow 7.81. If a copy of the PTO-892 is being provided without correction use 7.83 instead. Use 7.82.01 if reference copies are being supplied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of Reference(s) Furnished (¶7.82.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of the following references not previously supplied are enclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only for foreign patent documents, non-patent literature, pending applications not stored in the image file wrapper (IFW) system, and other information not previously supplied. Reference copies must be listed following this paragraph. Precede with 7.81 and may be used with 7.82 or 7.83.

rubrics_metrics.name: How To Obtain Copies of U.S. Patents and U.S. Patent Application Publications / E-Patent Reference (¶7.82.03)
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. patents and U.S. patent application publications are available from the USPTO website, for a fee from the Office of Public Records, and from commercial sources. E-Patent Reference (Private PAIR) provides electronic access for downloading cited U.S. patents and application publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access to Private PAIR required. Office urges obtaining a no-cost USPTO PKI digital certificate, customer number, associate filings with customer number, install free software to access Private PAIR and E-Patent Reference, and make internet arrangements. Steps and links provided; high-speed internet recommended. Recommended for use in Office actions citing U.S. patents/publications when applicant is not represented by registered practitioner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of Office Action Supplied (¶7.83)
rubrics_metrics.description: [1] of the last Office action is enclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 explain what is enclosed, e.g., 'A corrected copy', 'A complete copy', 'Pages 3-5', or 'A Notice of References Cited, Form PTO-892'. This paragraph should follow 7.81 and may follow 7.82 and 7.82.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Is Non-Responsive to Interview (¶7.84)
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive to the prior Office action because it fails to include a complete or accurate record of the interview. Applicant is given a TIME PERIOD of TWO (2) MONTHS to supply omission/correction to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensions of time may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a). In bracket 2 insert the date of the interview. In bracket 3 explain the deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Non-Responsive to Interview - AE Variant (¶7.84.AE) and Paper Unsigned - AE (¶7.84.01.AE)
rubrics_metrics.description: For AE applications, non-responsive replies or unsigned proposed replies trigger a TWO (2) MONTHS period to correct; filing for extension of time will result in removal from AE program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AE-specific notes: application granted special status under AE; extensions under 1.136(a) may be granted but will remove AE status; to meet AE objective replies must be filed electronically via EFS-Web; if not filed electronically final disposition may occur later than 12 months. Examiner should first try to contact applicant by telephone to obtain signed reply before mailing unsigned notice (for non-final actions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Under 37 CFR 1.312 Entered (¶7.85)
rubrics_metrics.description: The amendment filed on [1] under 37 CFR 1.312 has been entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for amendments under 1.312 that do not affect scope of claims (may be signed by primary examiner) and for amendments being entered under 1.312 which do affect scope of claims (requires signature of supervisory patent examiner). See MPEP § 714.16.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Entered in Part (¶7.86)
rubrics_metrics.description: When a proposed 1.312 amendment contains plural changes, some acceptable and some not, the acceptable changes should be entered; the acceptable and non-acceptable changes and explanation should be indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 2 indicate which changes have and have not been entered with appropriate explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bona Fide, Non-Responsive Amendments (¶7.95)
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive because of omission(s) or matter(s): [2]. Since the reply appears bona fide, applicant is given TWO (2) MONTHS to correct to avoid abandonment. Proposed amendment filed under 37 CFR 1.132 has not been entered: [2].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensions may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a). Reasons for non-entry should be specified in bracket 2 (e.g., 'The amendment changes the scope of the claims').

rubrics_metrics.name: Abandonment for Failure to Reply (¶7.90)
rubrics_metrics.description: This application is abandoned due to applicant’s failure to submit a proper reply to the Office action mailed on [1] within the required period for reply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A letter of abandonment should not be mailed until after the period for requesting an extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(a) has expired. In pro se cases see form paragraph 7.98.02.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reply Is Not Fully Responsive, Extension of Time Suggested (¶7.91)
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive to the prior Office action because: [2]. Since the period for reply has expired, the application will become abandoned unless applicant corrects the deficiency and obtains an extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify deficiencies in bracket 2 and advise applicant about extension options.
